svg.text: #614 Enterprise HR & Talent AI: EU AI Act Blind Skills Matcher & Voice Roleplay Coach
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 500K Resumes/Mo + 20,000 Roleplay Learners · 4/5ths Disparate Impact Ratio >= 0.94 · $0.74/Employee/Mo (-98.4%)
1. EU AI Act Annex III Compliant Blind Talent Matcher
✕ Why Raw Resume-to-LLM Ranking Violates Employment Laws
• Unmasked names, photos, graduation years & zip codes induce demographic bias
• Fails EEOC 4/5ths Disparate Impact Rule (Ratio = 0.68 < 0.80 legal floor!)
✓ 3-Stage Demographic-Blind Skills Ontology Pipeline (2× L40S)
• Stage 1 (GLiNER Blind Gate · 4.5ms): Strips name, gender pronouns, age, photo,
marital status & zip code BEFORE any vector embedding or LLM prompt!
• Stage 2 (ESCO / O*NET Skills Graph + BGE-M3): Maps experience to 13,800
standardized competencies & outputs XGrammar rubric evidence quotes
• Result: Disparate Impact Ratio rises from 0.68 to 0.94 (>=0.80 Law 144 Pass!)
2. 20,000-Employee Voice Roleplay Simulator & TCO
Interactive Sales & Compliance Voice Roleplay (40,000 Hours/Mo)
• 20,000 reps practice objection handling & regulatory disclosures (2 hrs/mo each)
• WebRTC Streaming Cascade (#581) + Multi-LoRA Customer Personas (#586)
• Post-Session 72B Scorecard evaluates empathy, compliance & product accuracy
Global Enterprise HR & L&D Platform TCO Comparison
• Commercial AI Coaching + Recruiting SaaS ($45/seat × 20K): $900,000/month
• Self-Hosted HR + Roleplay Fleet: 6× L40S (Blind Matcher + STT/TTS) + 4× H100
= 10 GPUs ($14,900/month = $0.74 / employee / month — 98.3% Cost Reduction!)
• Saves $10.62M/year while guaranteeing 100% employee PII & salary data sovereignty
3. Counterfactual Fairness Perturbation Test (Pre-Deployment Gate)
• Before deploying any recruiting prompt/model, run a 1,000-resume counterfactual swap test (swapping gendered/ethnic names).
• With Stage-1 GLiNER demographic blind-masking active, score variance across counterfactual name swaps is strictly 0.000 pts!
